description: This Java class 'UserDetailsMapper' converts application-specific User objects into Spring Security's UserDetails objects for authentication purposes. It uses user attributes such as email, password, active status, lock status, and roles to build the User object.

classes.name: UserDetailsMapper
classes.description: A component that maps custom User objects to Spring Security's UserDetails objects for authentication.

methods.name: toUserDetails
methods.description: Converts a custom user model to Spring Security's User details, mapping roles to authorities.
